voices.zh: 青春女声，灵动里带一点稳重，吐字清晰，语速从容
voices.en: youthful female voice, lively but a little composed, clear diction, unhurried pace

zh.text: 先把名称、场景和规则说清楚，再动手做交互。

en.text: Name the model, the scene, and the rule before you build the interaction.

zh.text: 菜单意图预测。根据指针轨迹，判断你是不是要进子菜单。
从一级斜着滑向二级时，指针会短暂经过中间其它项。若悬停到谁就展开谁，子菜单会被途中抢走。
子菜单打开后，用上一帧指针和子菜单左缘上下两点，构成一条安全走廊。斜向穿越时，只要还在走廊里，途经的项不会抢走子菜单。
沿一级列表上下移动、轨迹不朝向子菜单，则立刻切换。意图预测只保护像是要进去的那条斜线。
打开项目属性，再进项目标签，再斜向进入紧急。每一级都有自己的安全三角。进入子菜单后，走廊变绿。
指针越过子菜单左缘之后，走廊结束，也不再画反向三角。和一律加延迟不同：纵向扫不发黏，斜向才保护。

en.text: Menu intent prediction. From the pointer path, guess whether you are heading into the submenu.
Sliding diagonally from the first column into the second briefly crosses other items. If whichever item you hover opens, the submenu gets stolen mid-path.
After the submenu opens, the previous pointer sample and the leading-edge corners form a safe corridor. Stay inside on a diagonal, and passing items will not steal the submenu.
Moving up and down the first column, not toward the submenu, switches immediately. Intent only protects a path that looks like it is going in.
Open Project, then Project tags, then slide into Urgent. Each level has its own safe triangle. It turns green after you enter the submenu.
Once the pointer crosses the submenu's leading edge, the corridor ends, and we do not draw a reverse triangle. Unlike a flat delay: vertical scans stay snappy, diagonals stay protected.

zh.text: 给下拉起对名字。往下展开只是外观，真正要先定的是提交模型。
选择，扁平列表里只交一个值，点中即关。
多选择交的是一个集合。面板保持开着，标签可以单独摘掉。
分组选择仍然只交一个值。分组标题只是分类，不是层级。
级联选择必须走到叶子才提交一条路径。父级只展开，不能当成最终值。
分割按钮的主体立刻执行默认动作，只有箭头才打开低频菜单。
巨型导航不是表单值，是多列导航。点链接，或点其它导航项。
日期选择先入住再离店，过去不可选。两端齐了才是一段，晚数是日历日差。
最容易混的一对：分组选择是分类，级联选择才是上下级。先说名称、场景和规则，再谈外观。

en.text: Name the dropdown properly. Opening downward is only the skin. First decide the commit model.
Select commits one value from a flat list, and closes on pick.
Multi-select commits a set. The panel stays open, and chips can be removed one by one.
Grouped Select still commits one value. Group titles are filing, not hierarchy.
Cascader must reach a leaf before it commits a path. A parent only expands. It is not the final value.
On a Split Button, the body fires the default action at once. Only the chevron opens the infrequent menu.
A Mega Menu is not a form value. It is multi-column navigation. Click a link, or another nav item.
A date range is check-in, then check-out. Past days are locked. Only both ends make a span. Nights are calendar days.
The pair people mix up: Grouped is filing. Cascader is parent-child. Name it, name the scene, name the rule, then talk about looks.
